name: ref-audit-tamper
displayName: REF - Audit log or audit policy tampering
description: Security log cleared (1102), event logging service shut down (1100), or any event log cleared (System 104) - never filtered. Audit policy change (4719) only when made by a named account; MDM re-applying tenant audit policy as the machine account generates one event per subcategory, 54 at a time, and is excluded.

criteria.query:
union isfuzzy=true (SecurityEvent | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventID in (1100, 1102) | project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity, Actor=SubjectUserName), (SecurityEvent | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventID == 4719 | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" | project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity, Actor=SubjectUserName), (Event | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventLog == "System" and EventID == 104 and Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Eventlog" | project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity=substring(RenderedDescription,0,200), Actor=UserName) | extend LocalTime = format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(TimeGenerated,"America/Los_Angeles"),"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") | project LocalTime, Computer, EventID, Activity, Actor
| where EventID != 1100   // RA-027 12 Oct: 1100 = orderly shutdown; a killed log service writes none (silence rule covers it)
